title.en: A window over a satellite: throughput and sequence numbers
title.zh: 卫星链路上的窗口：吞吐量与序号

description.en: How long one round takes on a satellite link, how the window sets the throughput, how large a window keeps the link busy, and how many bits of sequence number Go-Back-N and Selective Repeat need for it.
description.zh: 卫星链路上一轮要多久，窗口怎样决定吞吐量，多大的窗口能让链路一直忙，以及回退 N 帧和选择重传为此各需要几位序号。

name.en: Sliding window: go-back-N and selective repeat
name.zh: 滑动窗口：回退 N 与选择重传 (go-back-N, selective repeat)

name.en: Flow control, stop and wait, ARQ
name.zh: 流量控制与停等协议 (flow control, stop and wait, ARQ)

name.en: Bandwidth and delay: transmission delay, propagation delay, latency
name.zh: 带宽与延迟：传输延迟和传播延迟 (bandwidth, transmission delay, propagation delay, latency)

name.en: TCP window management and flow control
name.zh: TCP 窗口管理与流量控制 (TCP window management, flow control)

description.en: Waiting one propagation time for an acknowledgement instead of a round trip
description.zh: 等确认时只算单程传播时间，而不是一个来回

title.en: A practice problem, in the style of the exam
title.zh: 练习题 · 仿考试题型

paras.en: Frames of 1000 bits are sent over a 1 Mbps channel using a geostationary satellite whose propagation time from the earth is 270 ms. Acknowledgements and headers are so short that their transmission time can be ignored.
paras.zh: 通过一颗地球同步卫星，在 1 Mbps 的信道上发送 1000 位的帧，从地面经卫星的传播时间为 270 ms。确认帧和首部都很短，它们的发送时间可以忽略。

paras.en: (a) What is the maximum throughput with stop-and-wait? (b) With a sliding window of 7 frames? (c) How large must the window be to keep the channel fully busy, and how many bits of sequence number does that need with Go-Back-N and with Selective Repeat?
paras.zh: (a) 用停等协议，最大吞吐量是多少？(b) 用 7 帧的滑动窗口呢？(c) 窗口要多大才能让信道一直满负荷？用回退 N 帧和选择重传，各需要几位序号？

items.en: **1000-bit frames on a 1 Mbps channel**: putting one frame on the channel takes $1000 / 10^6$ s = 1 ms, the transmission time.
items.zh: **1 Mbps 信道上的 1000 位帧**：把一帧放上信道要 $1000 / 10^6$ s = 1 ms，即发送时间。

items.en: **270 ms from the earth**: the time for a signal to go from one ground station, up to the satellite and down to the other. An acknowledgement needs the same time to come back.
items.zh: **从地面出发 270 ms**：信号从一个地面站上到卫星、再下到另一个地面站所需的时间。确认回来也要同样的时间。

items.en: **Acknowledgements and headers ignored**: as on the course's stop-and-wait slide, the time to send an acknowledgement is taken as 0. Only the 1000-bit frames and the propagation count.
items.zh: **忽略确认和首部**：和课件上停等协议那一页一样，发确认的时间记为 0。只算 1000 位的帧和传播时间。

items.en: **Throughput**: useful bits delivered per second, at most the channel's 1 Mbps.
items.zh: **吞吐量**：每秒送达的有用位数，最多是信道的 1 Mbps。

title.en: One round on a long link

text.en: A sender with a window of $W$ frames sends them, then must wait for an acknowledgement before it may send more. From its first bit, one **round** lasts the transmission time $T_f$, plus the propagation time $T_p$ for the frame to arrive, plus $T_p$ again for the acknowledgement to come back:
text.zh: 窗口为 $W$ 帧的发送方把它们发出去，然后必须等到确认才能再发。从第一位发出算起，一**轮**的时间是发送时间 $T_f$，加上帧传到对面的传播时间 $T_p$，再加上确认传回来的 $T_p$：

text.en: In that time it delivers $W$ frames, so the throughput is $W$ frames per round, up to the channel's own rate. On a satellite $T_p$ is huge compared with $T_f$, and the picture is mostly waiting:
text.zh: 这段时间里它送达 $W$ 帧，所以吞吐量是每轮 $W$ 帧，最多到信道本身的速率。在卫星上 $T_p$ 比 $T_f$ 大得多，画出来几乎全是在等：

alt.en: One round of 541 ms as a bar: a sliver of 1 ms sending at the left, the rest, 540 ms, waiting for the acknowledgement.
alt.zh: 一轮 541 ms 画成一根条：最左边细细的 1 ms 在发送，其余 540 ms 都在等确认。

caption.en: Stop-and-wait on the satellite: 1 ms of work in every 541.
caption.zh: 卫星上的停等协议：每 541 ms 只干 1 ms 的活。

text.en: To keep the channel busy, the window must hold every frame that can be sent in one round, and then the sequence numbers must be large enough for that window. The limits are those of the sliding-window lesson: Go-Back-N at most $2^n - 1$, Selective Repeat at most $2^{n-1}$, with $n$-bit sequence numbers.
text.zh: 要让信道一直忙，窗口得装下一轮之内能发出的全部帧；序号又得大到足够支持这个窗口。上限就是滑动窗口那一课讲的：序号 $n$ 位时，回退 N 帧最多 $2^n - 1$，选择重传最多 $2^{n-1}$。

say.en: Sending a frame takes 1 ms; the frame going and its acknowledgement coming back take 540 ms.
say.zh: 发一帧要 1 ms；帧过去、确认回来，共 540 ms。

say.en: From the first bit sent to the acknowledgement's arrival: one round.
say.zh: 从发出第一位到确认到达：一轮。

say.en: (a) Stop-and-wait: one frame per round, about 1.85 kbps, 0.18% of the channel.
say.zh: (a) 停等协议：每轮一帧，约 1.85 kbps，只用了信道的 0.18%。

say.en: (b) A window of 7: seven frames per round, about 12.9 kbps, still only 1.3% of the channel.
say.zh: (b) 7 帧的窗口：每轮七帧，约 12.9 kbps，仍然只用了信道的 1.3%。

say.en: (c) To keep sending for the whole round, the window must hold as many frames as fit into it: 541.
say.zh: (c) 要在整轮里一直发，窗口要装下一轮能发的全部帧：541 帧。

say.en: Go-Back-N allows a window of $2^n - 1$: $2^{10} - 1 = 1023$ is enough, $2^9 - 1 = 511$ is not.
Selective Repeat allows $2^{n-1}$: $2^{10} = 1024$ is enough, so 11 bits.

prompt.en: One round is the transmission time plus the time for the frame to go and the acknowledgement to come back. How many ms?
prompt.zh: 一轮等于发送时间，加上帧过去和确认回来的时间。多少 ms？

paras.en: Transmission time T_f = 1000 bits / 1 Mbps = 1 ms. A frame and its acknowledgement take 2 × 270 = 540 ms to go and come back (the acknowledgement's own transmission time is ignored), so one round takes 541 ms.
paras.zh: 发送时间 T_f = 1000 位 / 1 Mbps = 1 ms。帧过去、确认回来要 2 × 270 = 540 ms（确认自身的发送时间忽略不计），所以一轮 541 ms。

paras.en: (a) Stop-and-wait sends 1 frame per round: 1000 bits / 0.541 s ≈ 1.85 kbps (a utilisation of 1/541 ≈ 0.18%). (b) A window of 7: 7000 bits / 0.541 s ≈ 12.9 kbps (≈ 1.3%).
(c) To keep the channel busy the window must cover a whole round: W ≥ 541 / 1 = 541 frames. Go-Back-N needs 2ⁿ − 1 ≥ 541, so n = 10 bits; Selective Repeat needs 2ⁿ⁻¹ ≥ 541, so n = 11 bits.
paras.zh: (c) 要让信道一直满，窗口要覆盖一整轮：W ≥ 541 / 1 = 541 帧。回退 N 帧要求 2ⁿ − 1 ≥ 541，所以 n = 10 位；选择重传要求 2ⁿ⁻¹ ≥ 541，所以 n = 11 位。

text.en: The usual slip is to wait only 270 ms for the acknowledgement: it has to come back too.
text.zh: 常见的错是等确认只算 270 ms：确认也要传回来。

text.en: The window that fills a link is its **bandwidth-delay product**: the bandwidth times the round trip, the number of bits *in flight* when the link is full. Here $10^6 \times 0.541 \approx 541\,000$ bits, 541 frames. Any sliding-window protocol whose window is smaller than this leaves the link partly idle, however fast the link is.
text.zh: 能填满一条链路的窗口，就是它的**带宽时延积**：带宽乘往返时间，即链路满载时*在路上*的位数。这里是 $10^6 \times 0.541 \approx 541\,000$ 位，541 帧。任何滑动窗口协议，只要窗口比它小，链路就有一部分时间闲着，无论链路多快。

text.en: TCP is limited the same way. Its window field has 16 bits, so without the window scale option (RFC 7323) a sender may have at most 65 535 bytes unacknowledged, and its throughput is at most the window divided by the round trip: over a 20 ms path, $65\,535 \times 8 / 0.02 \approx 26.2$ Mbps, whatever the link's speed. A 1 Gbps path with a 20 ms round trip has a bandwidth-delay product of 2.5 MB, which is why the window scale option exists.
text.zh: TCP 也受同样的限制。它的窗口字段只有 16 位，所以不用窗口扩大选项（RFC 7323）时，发送方最多只能有 65 535 字节未确认，吞吐量最多是窗口除以往返时间：在 20 ms 的路径上，是 $65\,535 \times 8 / 0.02 \approx 26.2$ Mbps，不管链路多快。往返 20 ms 的 1 Gbps 路径，带宽时延积是 2.5 MB，窗口扩大选项就是为此而设的。

prompt.en: On the same link, what is the throughput with a window of 127 frames, in kbps (to the nearest whole number)?
prompt.zh: 同一条链路，窗口为 127 帧时，吞吐量是多少 kbps（取整）？

explain.en: $127\,000 / 0.541 \approx 235$ kbps: still under a quarter of the channel.
explain.zh: $127\,000 / 0.541 \approx 235$ kbps：仍不到信道的四分之一。

prompt.en: With 3-bit sequence numbers, which protocol gets more throughput over this satellite link?
prompt.zh: 序号只有 3 位时，在这条卫星链路上哪个协议的吞吐量更高？

label.en: Go-Back-N: its window can be 7, against 4 for Selective Repeat
label.zh: 回退 N 帧：它的窗口能到 7，选择重传只能到 4

label.en: Selective Repeat: it never resends good frames
label.zh: 选择重传：它从不重发好帧

feedback.en: With no errors there is nothing to resend; throughput is set by the window alone: 7 frames per round against 4.
feedback.zh: 没有出错时就没什么可重发；吞吐量只由窗口决定：每轮 7 帧对 4 帧。

label.en: The same: both send one window per round
label.zh: 一样：两者每轮都发一窗

feedback.en: Yes, one window per round, but the windows differ: $2^3 - 1 = 7$ against $2^{3-1} = 4$.
feedback.zh: 每轮确实都发一窗，但窗口大小不同：$2^3 - 1 = 7$ 对 $2^{3-1} = 4$。

explain.en: Without errors, the window decides: 7000 bits per round (12.9 kbps) against 4000 (7.4 kbps). Selective Repeat pays off only when errors are frequent.
explain.zh: 不出错时，窗口说了算：每轮 7000 位（12.9 kbps）对 4000 位（7.4 kbps）。选择重传只有在错误频繁时才划算。

title.en: Your turn: TCP over the satellite

prompt.en: A TCP connection without window scaling (a window of at most 65 535 bytes) runs over the same satellite, with a round trip of 0.541 s. What is its maximum throughput, in Mbps (two decimals)?
prompt.zh: 一条不用窗口扩大选项的 TCP 连接（窗口最多 65 535 字节）跑在同一颗卫星上，往返 0.541 s。最大吞吐量是多少 Mbps（保留两位小数）？

explain.en: $65\,535 \times 8 / 0.541 \approx 0.97$ Mbps: one full window per round trip, just under the 1 Mbps channel. On a faster satellite link, the 16-bit window field would be the limit.
explain.zh: $65\,535 \times 8 / 0.541 \approx 0.97$ Mbps：每个往返一整窗，刚好低于 1 Mbps 的信道。在更快的卫星链路上，16 位的窗口字段就成了瓶颈。
